# llms-full.txt — 2140.wtf publishes no expanded corpus

There is nothing to concatenate here, and saying so is more useful than serving
an empty file with a longer name.

2140.wtf is a static client. It serves one page — the app shell — plus its
assets and the documents beside it. The content the app "contains" (notes,
rooms, markets, wallet state, media) lives on Nostr relays and is fetched at
runtime; it is not hosted here and cannot be. A generated `llms-full.txt` would
therefore be a longer filename in front of the same words.

The complete written surface is:

- `/llms.txt` — this host, as markdown (also at `/llms.md` and
  `/.well-known/llms.txt`)
- `/AGENTS.md` — the agent onboarding guide
- `/CHAT_PROTOCOL.md` — the community-chat wire protocol
- `/.well-known/agent.json` — the machine manifest

Source and full product documentation: <https://github.com/2140wtf/2140wtf>.
